comment: Prepped creature roster from the 2026-08-02 dump: models stripped of animations, clips broken out into per-creature move libraries. Both creatures ride the same 24-joint Meshy biped skeleton as the resident hero models, so ResidentMovesLibrary.apply() can also graft Evelyn's full 10-clip set onto either of them when a director wants more than the indexed clips. The lamia was requested but absent from the dump.

harpy.notes: Winged, taloned; wings skinned to the arm chain, so arm clips read as wing gestures.
